Robinhood Chain Goes Live With Tokenized Stocks and a Key Ownership Caveat

Robinhood Chain tokenized stocks launched Wednesday in 120+ countries, but the new Stock Tokens are debt securities—not equity—meaning holders receive no shareholder rights. The SEC's January 2026 guidance flagged this exact structure for heightened scrutiny, as Robinhood also debuted a 7% DeFi yiel
